title: The Navigator's Shibboleth
logline: A guild of deep-space gate pilots enforces exorbitant transit tariffs by claiming an unstable jump corridor requires a secret vocal harmonic password, hunted by enforcers when a banished navigator attempts to broadcast the acoustic frequency.

roles.description: A banished guild navigator who knows the secret acoustic gate code; desperate to escape guild hit squads and start fresh.
High-ranking official in the gate guild who ruthlessly protects transit monopolies by silencing defectors.
A modified fast scout ship deployed by the guild to track and pin down defectors.
A heavy armed warship guarding the outer gate perimeter in a neighbouring system.
The fortified jump gate terminus in the starting system where transit fees are collected.
A remote orbital sensor mast in a neighbouring system containing archival gate calibration records.
An independent station in a third system beyond guild operational reach.

public_situation: Transit fees through the sector jump corridors soar as guild pilots claim solar storm flares require specialized vocal harmonic clearance.
private_truth: The sacred harmonic shibboleth is an ordinary radio sub-carrier pulse that anyone with a common frequency generator can transmit to unlock the gates.

beats.public_change: The guild locks outbound gate lanes to all vessels lacking registered guild pilot certifications.

missions.reason: She hires the pilot to destroy a guild tracking interceptor that has boxed her into an asteroid anchorage before she can jump.
missions.private_fact: She carries the master vocal modulation chips hidden inside her prosthetic breathing valve.

beats.public_change: Guild security vessels issue shoot-on-sight warnings for unverified gate approaches in the neighbouring sector.

missions.reason: She needs the pilot to strike a guild patrol craft and recover its transponder crypt-key to bypass the perimeter blockade.
missions.private_fact: She was expelled from the guild because she refused to let an uninsured refugee shuttle drift to death in the gate wake.

beats.public_change: Private relay frequencies go silent as guild monitoring ships search communications channels.

missions.reason: She pays the pilot to courier the decrypted transponder codes to an offline relay mast before search squads locate her sanctuary.
missions.private_fact: She served twenty years as the guild's chief gate keeper before discovering the resonance fraud.

beats.public_change: Sensor beacons around {role:sub_relay_spire} emit distorted gate interference telemetry.

missions.reason: She asks the pilot to scan the relay mast to verify that the gate resonance is a simple sub-carrier tone rather than a hazardous anomaly.
missions.private_fact: Her vocal cords were scarred by a guild disciplinary shock collar during her escape from the inner docks.

beats.public_change: {role:guild_picket_cruiser} ambushes the renegade as she approaches {role:freeport_haven_dock}.

missions.reason: She contracts the pilot to attack the pursuing cruiser so she can dock and broadcast the frequency key.
missions.private_fact: The cruiser captain hails mid-battle offering a lifetime gate transit pass and a massive cash buyout if the pilot turns the navigator over to guild custody.

player_choice.prompt: The guild picket cruiser is disabled outside the freeport. The renegade navigator holds the decrypted acoustic gate key, awaiting the pilot's final signal.

options.label: Broadcast the acoustic gate frequency across public relay channels to shatter the guild monopoly
Help the navigator slip into the rim with the private gate key to start an independent route

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot disables the guild cruiser and broadcasts the gate frequency openly.
resolutions.summary: The acoustic gate key is published openly across all networks. The transit monopoly collapses, and {role:renegade_navigator} secures safe asylum.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot shielded a rogue navigator while she broadcast the secret radio key, shattering the gate guild's transit monopoly.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the guild's transit pass bribe and hands over the navigator.
resolutions.summary: {role:renegade_navigator} is taken into guild custody and silenced. {role:guild_warden} maintains the monopoly, and gate tariffs double across three systems.

consequences.public_summary: Word travels that a pilot took a golden transit pass to betray a runaway gate pilot back to guild enforcers.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot disables the cruiser but helps the navigator keep the code private for her own crew.
resolutions.summary: {role:renegade_navigator} vanishes into the unmapped rim with her private gate key. {role:guild_warden} retains local monopolies while living in fear of future leaks.

consequences.public_summary: A rebel gate runner slipped into dark space with the secret codes, leaving guild enforcers empty-handed.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot fails to intervene or the scan data is lost.
resolutions.summary: Guild enforcers apprehend {role:renegade_navigator} in deep space. The acoustic shibboleth remains a closely guarded secret, and exorbitant tariffs continue.

loose_threads.detail: Gate receiver logs show the opening lock triggers on a standard 1420 megahertz acoustic tone rather than vocal magic.
Gate passage tariffs funnel twenty percent of all collected tolls into private accounts held by customs directors.
A former guild navigator was logged at three different stations using identical vocal timbre files from a synthesized soundboard.

radio_hooks: Gate guild raises transit insurance premiums across three sectors, citing unstable vocal corridor harmonics.
Independent freight haulers protest gate tolls, demanding independent scientific audits of the jump resonance.
Armed guild security cutters reported in pursuit of an unidentified rogue shuttle near sector border gates.

voice_direction.renegade_navigator: Hoarse, strained cadence that catches on sharp consonants due to damaged vocal cords. Intense, hurried, fiercely determined.
voice_direction.guild_warden: Silky, arrogant, aristocratic diction. Speaks with effortless condescension and treats technical questions as vulgar insolence.
